verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's own docs show cases have an assignee, and the assignee can add approvers within a review when the workflow allows peer approvals. Workflows can be configured to mirror the customer's policies, and the platform "moves cases between agents and your team." That covers the core of assignment plus review/approval routing, but escalation stages and how an operations lead actually assigns or reassigns cases are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of case assignment/reassignment by a lead, defined escalation stages, details of multi-stage analyst-to-escalation routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
